biggest_catch: Nothing is paid until your cash back is confirmed — which typically takes 3–14 weeks — and then you still wait for the next quarterly payment date; balances of $5.00 or less roll over to the next quarter.
catches: Cashback rates vary by store and can change; cashback is not guaranteed income.
Many purchases are excluded from cash back (per the official Account FAQ: returns, exclusions, and coupons not found on Rakuten can make an order ineligible — gift cards are commonly excluded).
Minimum $5.01 in confirmed earnings required for a quarterly payment; $5.00 or less carries over.
Pending cash back typically takes 3–14 weeks to confirm (online 20–100 days, travel 45–120 days).
If you don't click through Rakuten before buying — or an ad blocker / another coupon extension interferes — the affiliate cookie can break and the purchase won't credit.
Rakuten tracks your purchases and, for in-store cash back, linked card activity — a real privacy trade-off.

steps: Install the Rakuten browser extension (or use the Rakuten app/site) and create a free account.
Add your address in Account Settings and choose how you get paid (Big Fat Check, PayPal, Amex Membership Rewards points, or Bilt).
Click through Rakuten before shopping at a participating store — disable ad blockers and competing coupon/cashback extensions.
Complete the purchase; cash back posts as pending, then moves to confirmed (typically 3–14 weeks).
Once you have $5.01+ in confirmed earnings before a payment date, you are paid automatically on the next quarterly date (Feb 15 / May 15 / Aug 15 / Nov 15).
If you want it sooner, redeem $5+ in confirmed cash back for a gift card (40+ brands) and receive it by email within minutes.
